newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to end contracts of pre-shipment firms.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to end contracts of pre-shipment firms.

text.p: Pakistan will terminate the contracts of two Swiss pre-shipment inspection firms, Petroleum and Natural Resources Minister Javed Jabbar said on Thursday.
He told the Senate (upper house) that the government had paid a total of 4.39 billion rupees ($109 million) to Cotecna and SGS from January 1995 to September 1996.
Jabbar said the caretaker government led by Prime Minister Meraj Khalid had decided to terminate their contracts, but did not say when this would happen.
He said the ousted government of Benazir Bhutto had earlier taken the same decision in principle, on cost grounds.
He said that 40 percent of exports had already been exempted from pre-shipment inspection.
Executives of Cotecna and SGS could not immediately be reached for comment.
